### Are You Willing to Change Course?
Author: Jim Liebelt
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/homeword/homeword-may-16-2014.html
Passage: Proverbs 14:12
Points:
- Stubbornly refusing to adjust your position damages both human relationships and your walk with God.
- Insisting on getting your own way builds walls that can ultimately destroy relationships.
- Demanding your own path with God reduces Him to a tool for personal desires.
- Following a course that merely feels right can bring spiritual shipwreck and ruin.
- True wisdom requires the humility to change direction and seek forgiveness.

### Orange Cone Alert
Author: Leslie Snyder
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/homeword/orange-cone-alert-homeword-april-.html
Passage: Proverbs 14:12
Points:
- Spiritual growth entails uncomfortable detours, delays, and frustrations similar to road construction.
- Quick fixes in spiritual life only patch the surface and mask underlying decay.
- Outward religious activity cannot substitute for deep, transformative work in the soul.
- Lasting spiritual health requires honest self-examination, perseverance, and discipline.
- Submitting to God's restructuring work leads to genuine healing and spiritual freedom.

### Are You Lost?
Author: Charles R. Swindoll
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/todays-insight-chuck-swindoll/today-s-insight-june-17-2014.html
Passage: Proverbs 14:12
Points:
- Personal sincerity and confidence do not guarantee that a person is headed the right way.
- Paths that seem sensible and receive social admiration can still end in death.
- Trusting internal feelings over objective truth leads to spiritual disaster.
- God's Word functions as an accurate navigational panel to keep lives on course.
- Deliverance from spiritual disorientation is found through Jesus Christ.
